ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw $AM\perp BC$ at M and $GN\perp BC$ at N through point A and G respectively, and connect GM,\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral EFGH is a rectangle,\\
$\therefore \angle AFB=\angle AED=\angle BGC=\angle CHD=90^\circ$,\\
$\because FA=FB=2\sqrt{2}$,\\
$\therefore AB=\sqrt{AF^{2}+BF^{2}}=4$, $\angle ABF=\angle BAF=45^\circ$,\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus, $\angle ABC=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore AB=BC=CD=AD$, $\angle ABC=\angle ADC=60^\circ$, $\angle BAD=\angle BCD=120^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle CBG=15^\circ$, $\angle DAF=75^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle CDH=\angle DCH=45^\circ$, $\angle ADE=15^\circ$, $\angle BCG=75^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAF=\angle DCH=\angle ABF=\angle CDH$, $\angle ADE=\angle CBG$, $\angle DAE=\angle BCG$,\\

$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle BAF=\angle DCH\\
AB=CD\\
\angle ABF=\angle CDH
\end{array}\right.$,\\
$\therefore \triangle ABF \cong \triangle CDH(ASA)$,\\
Similarly, $\triangle BCG \cong \triangle DAE(ASA)$,\\
$\because AM\perp BC$, $\angle ABC=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAM=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore BM=\frac{1}{2}AB=2$,\\
$\therefore AM=\sqrt{3}BM=2\sqrt{3}$, $BC=2BM$,\\
$\because \angle BGC=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore BM=CM=GM=2$,\\
$\therefore \angle CMG=2\angle CBG=30^\circ$,\\

$\therefore GN=\frac{1}{2}GM=1$,\\

$\because FA=FB=2\sqrt{2}$,\\
$\therefore AB=\sqrt{AF^{2}+BF^{2}}=4$, $\angle ABF=\angle BAF=45^\circ$,\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus, $\angle ABC=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore AB=BC=CD=AD$, $\angle ABC=\angle ADC=60^\circ$, $\angle BAD=\angle BCD=120^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle CBG=15^\circ$, $\angle DAF=75^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle CDH=\angle DCH=45^\circ$, $\angle ADE=15^\circ$, $\angle BCG=75^\circ$,\\

AB=CD\\
